tools.name: recommend_resources
tools.description: Find a shortlist for a task. Keyword relevance precedes repository stars. Optional client preference is evidence, not tested compatibility. Requirements such as free or local-only must be checked upstream.

tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search precise keywords across skills, MCP servers, plugins, agents, prompts and rules. Returns at most 24 results per page.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Get a resource's compatibility evidence, freshness and upstream setup link by its catalog ID. Does not install or execute anything.
